BiblicalUsage: Secacah was a town in the wilderness of Judah, named among Beth-arabah and Middin in the allotment of the land. It is one of the small wilderness towns that fill out Judah's border.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God gives His people towns even in the wilderness, and Secacah is one of the names that proves no corner of the inheritance was left out.
